sentences.text: After service of notice, the official Respondents have entered appearance through the learned AGA and the Respondent-Housing Society is represented by the learned Panel Counsel who has filed the Statement of Objections.
Both they point out about the earlier rounds of litigation unsuccessfully fought by the Petitioners herein and their predecessors, as well.
The counsel representing the Petitioners herein had represented them in one case which refers to all earlier judgments suffered by them at the hands of the Coordinate Benches.
All that has been suppressed by the Petitioners and their counsel in the present Writ Petitions.

3. When the Coordinate Bench judgments were confronted to the advocate appearing for the Petitioners on record, who himself had argued one of those cases earlier, he seeks leave to withdraw the Petitions offering unconditional apology.
This Court having noticed a kind of culpable conduct on the part of the arguing counsel Mr.Suresh K, wanted to refer the matter to the Karnataka State Bar Council for disciplinary action.

4. On solicitation, a few tall members of the Bar namely Smt. Shilpa Shah (Sr. Panel Counsel for NHAI), Mr.K.Krishna (Sr. Panel Counsel for BDA), Prof. Lakshmeesh Rao (Sr. Panel Counsel for BDA) & Mr.R.Srinivasa Gowda (AGA) suggested that instead of referring the matter to the Bar Council, the advocate for the Petitioners may be let after administering a censure and that he be asked to undergo counselling.

Accordingly, this court censured him, with a direction to undergo counselling for one hour each at the law chambers of Prof. Lakshmeesh Rao, Mr.K.Krishna &
Smt.Shilpa Shah, after taking prior appointment in the next four weeks and to show to the Registrar General of this Court the Certificates of Counselling issued by them.
While making this order, the fair opinion of learned Advocate appearing for the respondent-Housing Society Mr.K.R.Krishna Murthy is also noted.
5. The above lenient view having been taken, leave as sought for, has been accorded to the Petitioners to withdraw both the petitions.
Ordered accordingly & Writ Petitions are disposed off, costs having been reluctantly made easy.
The Registrar General of this Court shall ensure compliance of the instructions issued to the advocate on record namely Mr.Suresh K.
A copy of this order be shared with the learned aforesaid members of the Bar and with the advocate on record for the Petitioners for information & needful action.

Sd/-
